name: Lucinka
description: A former Azorius precognition mage who left after thirty-seven years and now runs a seer's shop, who guides the trio to free Zita and the prisoners.

timeline.summary: Kodolaag and Olrich visit the precognition mage Lucinka, who gives them a box and instructions for freeing Zita.
timeline.quote: Visit Udzec tomorrow morning. Get in line behind the minotaur with a curly red mane.

timeline.summary: Lucinka tells Zita, Olrich and Kodolaag they can never return to their old lives and should form a troupe in the undercity to hunt dangerous escapees.
timeline.quote: You'll have to set up new lives in the undercity,
